scene_sienna_00_intro.text: Sienna lounges at the edge of the pool, legs kicking lazily in the glowing water. When she spots you watching, she splashes playfully and lifts one brow, grin wide and wicked.

scene_riley_00_intro.text: Riley finishes a sharp, fluid gymnastic pivot and laughs breathlessly. "Didn’t see you there. Enjoying the show?"

scene_luna_00_intro.text: Luna watches you approach with a slow, assessing gaze—like she's reading a page no one else can see. Her voice is low and velvety. "You carry a strange gravity. Sit with me a moment."

scene_harper_00_intro.text:
Harper Vale — instantly recognizable, magnetic in person — stands in a warm halo of lanternlight near a wide loft window, the city sprawled in glittering layers below. She swirls her drink, watching reflections glide across the glass and polished game tables nearby.

"You look like someone with better stories than half the people here," she says with a sly, cinematic smile.

Her voice is low, velvet-smooth — the kind of tone that makes everything sound like a line delivered perfectly on the first take.

scene_mara_00_intro.text: Mara stands near a tall loft window, hair glowing softly in the city light. A quiet two-person table sits nearby with an untouched game laid out between the chairs. "You’re just in time," she says, nodding toward the view. "The city puts on its best performance after midnight."
